notes: BUB1B compound heterozygote (NM_001211.6 / ENST00000287598). Allele 1: p.Leu737Ter, stop-gain in exon 17 of 23, expected to trigger nonsense-mediated decay; ClinVar 533901 Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic for mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 1; gnomAD AF 7.9e-05. Allele 2: p.Asn1002Lys, missense in the kinase domain, seen once in 1.46 million gnomAD alleles; not in ClinVar under this nucleotide change. These are the only two protein-altering variants in the gene. Phase cannot be determined from this data.

Stop-gain allele alone, in case the second hit is something this call set cannot show (for example a balanced rearrangement). Exon-level deletions are excluded: all 23 coding exons have 0.77 to 1.44 times the median read depth.

Stop-gain allele plus the only other novel (absent from dbSNP) heterozygous variant in BUB1B, a deep intronic change 1,026 bp from the nearest exon. Less likely than row 2: SpliceAI predicts no splicing effect (0.00).

SECONDARY FINDING, unrelated to the primary diagnosis. LZTR1 p.Tyr748Ter (ENST00000646124): stop-gain expected to trigger nonsense-mediated decay; ClinVar 1409252 Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic. Heterozygous loss of LZTR1 function is associated with schwannomatosis (autosomal dominant, incomplete penetrance), for which clinical follow-up can be considered. It does not explain this condition: Noonan syndrome 10 is caused by dominant missense variants and Noonan syndrome 2 needs variants in both copies of LZTR1. Needs confirmation in an accredited laboratory and review by the treating team.
